'''Artzy Tyrannical''' is a 6★ [[Handcannon]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Item description|A weapon equipped by Endfield operators to significantly boost their combat capabilities.|One of the most popular products from Mieszko Industries from their bold Fine Artists Collab series. These firearms feature great styles that match their wildly violent performance. Their popularity is proven by the premium they command in secondary markets.}}
